topic: How does antenna design influence the accuracy of encrypted traffic classification systems in heterogeneous satellite networks?
response: Antenna design affects signal quality, impacting encrypted traffic classification accuracy. Better designs reduce fading and interference, improving signal-to-noise ratio and thus classification performance.
reference_context: SatCom systems involve LEO, GW, and ABS with Rayleigh fading, affecting signal quality and potentially classification accuracy in heterogeneous networks.
